changes_from_original_brief: 22 mm seal-free piston; 50 mm cylinder; spring seats 28/11/8 mm
Piston O-ring groove and rear O-ring removed; no separate bleed outlet
Rear joint uses a shallow tape annulus; adhesion and sealing require a bench test
Four printed through-pins and C clips replace the four M3 cap screws
PLA reed and printed blind push pin replace silicone flap and M2 screw
Reed anchor moved to Y0, Z+7 for a longer flexing neck within the bore
Top-only base relief behind the cylinder resolves the rear-cap/base clash
unresolved: Actual finished bore/piston roundness, taper, friction and leakage
PLA reed closure, reopening and fatigue; no silicone valve is used
Printed pin and clip retention, including actual printer clearance
Tape annulus compressed thickness, airtightness and cap adhesion
Piano-wire spring rate, measured solid length and reset force
Hinge driving force, door trajectory and tape shear/peel loads
